name: text-to-cad
readmeExcerpt:
Design physical products with AI. [Website](https://www.texttocad.dev) · [Docs](https://www.texttocad.dev/docs)
# text-to-cad ## 🚀 Quickstart macOS and Linux: ```bash curl -fsSL https://texttocad.dev/install.sh | sh ``` Windows, in PowerShell: ```powershell irm https://www.texttocad.dev/install.ps1 | iex ``` It installs uv if it is missing, then `cad`, the command text-to-cad runs on, then the plugin in each agent app it finds on your computer, with that app's own command (Kimi Code you install by hand), and turns on automatic updates. Then ask your agent for a part or an assembly: it writes the model as a Python script, runs it to build the model and shows it in the viewer. It works in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Antigravity, Devin CLI, Factory Droid, GitHub Copilot CLI, Kimi Code, Muse, Pi, Qwen Code, Amp, Cline, Goose, Hermes Agent, Kilo Code, Kiro CLI, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Roo Code, Trae and Windsurf. Installing by hand, app by app, updating and removing: [docs/install.md](docs/install.md) ## ✨ Features The text-to-cad plugin gives your agent local workflows to generate 3D models as STEP, GLB, STL or 3MF files, check them for manufacturing, draw them, and connect to 3D printing, sheet metal and CNC services. It works with any agent that supports plugins or skills. - [**Parts and assemblies**](skills/cad/SKILL.md): Models written as Python scripts with [build123d](https://github.com/gumyr/build123d) and [OpenCASCADE](https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT), exported as STEP, STL, 3MF or GLB, and as [DXF profiles and flat patterns](skills/cad/references/2d-profiles-and-dxf.md) for laser and waterjet cutting, with joints and animations for mechanisms, and shown live in the viewer. - [**Circuit boards**](skills/pcb/SKILL.md): KiCad schematics and boards, placed and routed, checked with ERC and DRC, reviewed before you order, and exported as fabrication files. - [**Manufacturing checks**](skills/cad/SKILL.md#can-it-be-made): Whether a part can be machined, cut and bent, molded or 3D printed, measured against the process's rules, and what to change where it cannot. - [**Stress checks**](skills/fea/SKILL.md): Whether a part or an assembly of bonded parts holds under its loads, solved with CalculiX: each part's peak stress, safety factor and how far it moves, drawn on the model. - [**Engineering drawings**](skills/engineering-drawing/SKILL.md): Dimensioned PDF sheets projected from the part's geometry: views, hidden lines, centre marks, hole callouts and a title block. - [**Renders**](skills/render/SKILL.md): Photoreal stills, turntables and films of a model with Blender, lit and framed in a Python script and run on the GPU, with a quick draft before each final. - [**Fabrication services**](skills/sendcutsend/SKILL.md): [Checks DXF and STEP files against SendCutSend's guide](skills/sendcutsend/SKILL.md) before you upload them, and [slices 3D prints](skills/print3d/SKILL.md) with OrcaSlicer and sends them to Bambu Connect or Bambu Studio. - [**Robotics and simulation**](skills/robot-simulation/SKILL.md): Robot and world descriptions for simulation and motion planning: URDF for ROS, SRDF for MoveIt and MJCF for MuJoCo. ## 🌐 Community Projects built on top of text-to-cad, and projects that text-to-cad uses. - **Studio**: A community app by @amywork777: an open-source desktop CAD app for mechanical engineers, built on text-to-cad, for Mac and Windows. You describe a part to the agent, and the 3D model, drawings, stress check and versions sit beside the chat, where you can also edit the model by hand. [Website](https://texttocad.studio) · [GitHub](https://github.com/amywork777/studio) - **build123d**: The Python CAD library text-to-cad's models are written in: parts and assemblies as code, with sketches, features and joints, built on OpenCASCADE. [Docs](https://build123d.readthedocs.io) · [GitHub](https://github.com/gumyr/build123d) - **OpenCASCADE**: The open-source geometry kernel under build123d: it builds the solids and reads and writes the STEP files. [Website](https://dev.opencascade.org) · [GitHub](https://github.com/Open-Cascade-SAS/OCCT) - **kicode**: KiCad's command line, kicad-cli, and its Python client, KiPy, in one Python package: the headless KiCad that text-to-cad's circuit boards run on, with nothing else of KiCad installed. Unofficial: not made or supported by the KiCad project. [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/kicode/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/earthtojake/kicode) ## 🛠️ Contributing text-to-cad is MIT-licensed and built in the open. - **Bugs and plugin requests**: [open an issue](https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad/issues/new). A bug report with the model script and the output of `cad doctor` is the fastest to fix, and an agent app without a plugin gets one on request. A security problem is reported privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) says. - **Questions, ideas and what you made**: the [Discord](https://discord.gg/5FGB9DwJYU). Say what the skills got wrong, too: that is what improves them. - **Code, skills and models**: a new skill (a fabrication service, a printer, a CAD workflow) goes in `skills/`, an example model in `models/`, and fixes anywhere. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) has the local setup, how to test in the agent apps, and the guidance for agents working in the repository. By default, text-to-cad sends usage stats and crash reports, tagged with a random ID and never including your files, paths or prompts. The [privacy policy](https://www.texttocad.dev/privacy-policy) says what is sent and how to turn it off, and the [terms of service](https://www.texttocad.dev/terms-of-service) govern using text-to-cad.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An AI-powered tool that generates programmatic CAD files directly from natural language text prompts.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Text-to-CAD is an innovative application that allows users to generate Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models simply by describing the desired object using natural language text prompts. It leverages Large Language Models to interpret the text and construct the 3D geometry programmatically, typically outputting code that defines the shape. This approach bridges the gap between conceptualization and 3D modeling, enabling rapid prototyping without requiring extensive knowledge of complex, graphical CAD software interfaces. It exports generated models into standardized formats like STEP, STL, and GLB, facilitating downstream fabrication and simulation.
keyFeatures: Natural Language Interface: Generate CAD models by describing them using everyday text prompts.
LLM Integration: Utilize Large Language Models to accurately interpret spatial descriptions and design intent.
Programmatic CAD Generation: Translate LLM output into precise programmatic instructions to define 3D geometries.
Rapid Prototyping: Significantly accelerate the initial design phase by automating the creation of basic 3D structures.
Code-Based Output: Produce designs in a programmatic format, allowing for version control and precise parametric adjustments.
Multi-Format Export: Export designs to standard CAD formats like STEP, STL, 3MF, and GLB for universal compatibility.

useCases.title: Rapid Concept Generation
useCases.description: Quickly visualizing a product idea by typing a description and instantly receiving a basic programmatic 3D model.

useCases.title: Accessible 3D Modeling
useCases.description: Enabling individuals without formal CAD training to create custom 3D objects for personal projects by simply describing them.

useCases.title: Design Brainstorming
useCases.description: Generating multiple variations of a design rapidly by tweaking the text prompts to explore different concepts.

useCases.title: Automated Handoffs
useCases.description: Automatically generating DXF files or valid G-code from natural language prompts to stream straight into fabrication equipment.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Makers, designers, engineers, and developers who want to quickly generate 3D models and prototypes programmatically without spending hours manually modeling in complex GUI-based CAD software. The platform simplifies complex workflows and accelerates development timelines.

## What's Changed

* Community: build123d, OpenCASCADE and kicode; Studio credited as a community app by @earthtojake in https://github.com/earthtojake/text-to-cad/pull/917
